scripts.infra:up: sh -c 'if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d; elif command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker-compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d; else echo "Docker Compose not found. Install Docker Compose v2 plugin or docker-compose."; exit 1; fi'
scripts.infra:down: sh -c 'if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v; elif command -v docker-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker-compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml down -v; else echo "Docker Compose not found. Install Docker Compose v2 plugin or docker-compose."; exit 1; fi'
